item.title: devops+ai: Full SDLC in a Single Skill Command
item.description:
The article title and subtitle suggest a workflow for managing the full software development lifecycle from Jira to production using a single command and a team of automated agents. No technical implementation details are provided in the excerpt.

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 7
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s Sept. 7 weekly release adds Jira integration in Copilot app and adaptive model orchestration via Project HydraFusion in Copilot CLI. It also introduces new agent automation in Visual Studio Code.

  • Source: GitHub
